entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to continue.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Finally! I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. And don't try to give me some runaround. These shoes gave me horrible blisters after just one class, and the cleats were a nightmare to adjust. I want a refund, and I want it now.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the purchase was delivered 26 days ago. I just need to quickly verify our return policy.

Don't you dare tell me I'm outside some ridiculous window! If you don't process this refund, I'm going straight to social media and leaving a review that will curl your hair. Put your manager on the phone right now!
That won't be necessary, ma'am. I've just confirmed the policy. For standard items like these shoes, you have a 90-day return window. You are well within that period.
Wait, really? So you're just going to approve it? No fight?

That's correct. I can process this return for you immediately. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label as we speak. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at a shipping center. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed.
Oh. Okay then. Well... thank you. I appreciate that.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
